title: ML training run (v1)
description: One fit, reported by the code that performed it. Everything here is a fact about the run rather than a judgement about it: the snapshot it was fitted to, the hyperparameters as fitted, the seed, the environment, the commit and the metrics. What the owner must still write -- the target definition, the intended and excluded uses, why the split does not leak -- is deliberately absent, because an argument is not captured, it is made. Fields are validated against the training schema server-side; unknown keys are rejected there rather than here, so a producer learns which field it got wrong.

ml_application_id.description: The ML Application this fit belongs to. Must already be registered: a train arriving for a record nobody has registered is a record nobody is accountable for.

fit_id.description: Identifies this fit. Re-reporting the same fit_id updates that train rather than adding another, so a run that reports twice does not become two trains.

fields.description: The captured values, keyed by training field. Only fields the platform marks capturable are accepted; anything else is refused with its name, because silently dropping a value a producer believed it had recorded is worse than rejecting it.
